gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-krub: Krub has a pronounced x-height and curves that lift off before closing, leaving its loops pleasantly unfinished beside the heading. Tilt Neon holds one tube-like stroke throughout, while Krub's lines loosen up underneath.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-kufam: A tube-like stroke of constant width gives Tilt Neon its sign-lit look, with a splayed c terminal. And while Tilt Neon owns the loud display moments, Kufam keeps lines readable with generously open curves.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-lexend: Tilt Neon is all bold, commanding tube lines, with a splayed c terminal and short ascenders. But make the heading small and its tube strokes lose their punch, while Lexend's open curves hold up fine.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-lexend-deca: Approachable Lexend Deca keeps a plain, unshaded line with terminals that stop short of curling, under Tilt Neon's tube-like heading. Tilt Neon handles the shouting; Lexend Deca does the quiet sans work.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-liter: Liter reads modern and professional, a sans with no stroke contrast and wide mouths on its round forms. Tilt Neon's tube-like lettering gets plenty of room to shout above it.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-mada: Mada reads approachable and modern, its curves refusing to close and its midzone towering. Tilt Neon, meanwhile, does the loud work with a constant tube stroke and slim joins like a pipe cleaner.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-martel-sans: No hairlines and no swells anywhere: Tilt Neon is one tube-like stroke with a splayed c terminal. Martel Sans counters with generous openings in every curve and a high mean line across each word.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-matangi: Contemporary Matangi presses twine-like strokes into the page, with rounded letters left open and a hefty lowercase. And under Tilt Neon's bold, tube-like headings, its chunky lowercase gives the eye somewhere to land.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-maven-pro: Neon tubes, then calm: Maven Pro brings a welcoming gap in the c and a high-waisted lowercase. And Tilt Neon earns its keep big and short, where its constant tube stroke can glow.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-michroma: Commanding Tilt Neon gives every stroke the same visual weight, like a lit tube. And Michroma, with wide berth on both sides of each letter and stubby ascenders, would read spacious and unhurried across text.
